items.title: Judge blocks FCC from punishing ABC in free speech case
items.feedTitle: Trump, FCC illegally sought to punish ABC in free speech case, judge rules
items.summary: A federal judge ruled that Trump and the FCC illegally sought to punish ABC News, granting a preliminary injunction that blocks the FCC from taking further action against the network's broadcast licenses. The judge said the case was "not a close case," finding the administration's actions violated free speech protections. This marks a significant legal setback for the administration's efforts to target the media outlet over its coverage.

items.title: New York declares emergency ahead of Thanksgiving storm
items.feedTitle: Hochul declares state of emergency in New York counties ahead of Thanksgiving storm
items.summary: New York Governor Kathy Hochul declared a state of emergency in New York City and several surrounding counties as a severe Thanksgiving storm approaches. The storm has already begun disrupting travel and weather forecasters predict significant wind and precipitation. Officials are preparing infrastructure and urging residents to prepare for potential hazards.

items.title: Second judge blocks Trump's birthright citizenship order
items.feedTitle: Trump's newest order curtailing birthright citizenship is blocked by second judge
items.summary: A second federal judge has blocked Trump's latest executive order attempting to restrict birthright citizenship, finding it likely violates the 14th Amendment. The ruling continues a series of judicial defeats for the administration's immigration policies. Legal experts say the constitutional protections remain intact pending further appeals.

items.title: Salvadoran mistakenly deported arrives in Spain
items.feedTitle: Kilmar Abrego García arrives in Spain to start a new life
items.summary: Kilmar Ábrego García, a Salvadoran national who was mistakenly deported by the Trump administration and became a symbol of mass deportation concerns, has voluntarily departed the United States and arrived in Spain. His lawyer described the move as temporary, with hopes of returning to his family in Maryland after the administration changes. The case highlighted errors in deportation procedures.

items.title: Macy's Thanksgiving parade postponed to Saturday
items.feedTitle: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed to Saturday due to expected bad weather
items.summary: The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, marking its 100th edition, has been postponed from Thursday to Saturday due to severe weather warnings of damaging winds and heavy rainfall across New York City. The delay marks the first time in the parade's history that it has been postponed due to weather. The event will still broadcast on television.

stlouis.title: St. Louis braces for unusual Thanksgiving snowstorm
stlouis.feedTitle: MoDOT, forecasters prepare for 'unusual' Thanksgiving snowstorm in St. Louis
stlouis.summary: MoDOT and weather forecasters are preparing for an unusually heavy snowstorm expected to impact the St. Louis area around Thanksgiving, with preparations underway for possible record snow levels. Officials are coordinating with transportation agencies to manage road conditions during one of the busiest travel periods of the year. The storm represents an atypical weather event for late November in the region.

stlouis.title: Former St. Louis circuit attorney Kim Gardner disbarred
stlouis.feedTitle: Former St. Louis City Circuit Attorney Kim Gardner disbarred
stlouis.summary: Kim Gardner, the former St. Louis City Circuit Attorney, has been disbarred following professional misconduct proceedings. This marks the conclusion of a legal process examining her conduct during her tenure in office. The disbarring removes her ability to practice law.

stlouis.title: Man dies while in St. Louis jail custody
stlouis.feedTitle: Man dies while in St. Louis jail custody, city officials say
stlouis.summary: A man has died while in custody at a St. Louis jail facility, according to city officials. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the death. Details remain limited pending the completion of the investigation.

items.title: Trump announces new tariffs on 14 trading partners
items.feedTitle: US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China
items.summary: The Trump administration unveiled a new round of tariffs targeting 14 major trading partners, including China, the EU, and others, with China facing a proposed 20% rate on most products. The administration says the tariffs are designed to address what it claims are unfair manufacturing practices and overcapacity in key sectors. Trading partners have already pushed back, with Brazil and China calling the measures unacceptable.

items.title: Fuel tanker fire kills at least 31 near Cairo
items.feedTitle: At least 31 killed as fuel tanker crash ignites large fire on Cairo highway
items.summary: A massive fire erupted when a fuel tanker crashed on a busy ring road surrounding Cairo, killing at least 31 people and injuring at least 21 others. The incident occurred on a key highway in Egypt and left vehicles charred in its wake. Egyptian authorities are investigating the cause of the crash and fire.

items.title: Ukraine strikes Russian military airbase east of Moscow
items.feedTitle: Ukraine attacks Russian military base, says five planes struck
items.summary: Ukrainian forces attacked an airbase in the Nizhny Novgorod region east of Moscow, with the Ukrainian General Staff claiming five military aircraft were struck. The attack represents an escalation in strikes on Russian military infrastructure far from the front lines. Russia has promised retaliation for the attack.

items.title: Record-high king tides flood California coastal communities
items.feedTitle: Record-breaking California tides cause major flooding of roads and businesses
items.summary: Record-breaking high tides driven by El Niño weather swept across the California coast on Wednesday, flooding roads, businesses, and beaches with seawater. Authorities warned residents to stay away from beaches as super tides combined with big wave action created dangerous conditions. Los Angeles and La Jolla experienced all-time high tides, with landmark piers affected.

items.title: Colombian police end supermarket hostage siege
items.feedTitle: All hostages rescued after Colombian security forces storm supermarket, police say
items.summary: Colombian security forces stormed a supermarket in Cartagena, ending a daylong siege in which all hostages were freed. One man described as a hostage-taker was killed, though questions remain about whether he may have been a hostage. President Dumont subsequently confronted the arrested men, characterizing the incident as a robbery gone wrong.

items.title: India pavilion wins Venice Biennale visitors' award
items.feedTitle: India Pavilion bags Visitors’ Lion at Venice Biennale; PM Modi calls it ‘proud moment for country’
items.summary: India's national pavilion at the Venice Biennale, themed "Geographies of Distance: Remembering Home," won the prestigious Visitors' Lion award. The pavilion explored memory and belonging in a rapidly transforming world. Prime Minister Modi called the win "a proud moment for the country" in a statement celebrating the cultural achievement.

items.title: US announces 25% tariffs on India, second-highest rate
items.feedTitle: U.S. announces new 25% tariffs on India, second-highest in the 14 countries against which action has been taken
items.summary: The Trump administration announced new 25% tariffs on India, the second-highest rate among 14 targeted nations, though the order leaves room for a reduced 17% rate if India and the US sign a trade deal. India is examining the USTR's Section 301 determination on manufacturing capacity claims. The tariff represents a significant trade development with implications for India's export sectors.

items.title: Trump tariffs on India: exemptions possible for key sectors
items.feedTitle: Trump slaps new tariffs on 14 nations; India faces additional 17%
items.summary: Analysis of Trump's proposed tariffs shows that certain Indian products in pharmaceuticals, auto, and metal sectors could potentially be exempt from the new 25% duty rate. Industry analysts are examining which goods might qualify for relief under the proposed tariff structure. The exemptions remain dependent on trade negotiations between the two countries.

items.title: Supreme Court issues notice on Delhi riots bail pleas
items.feedTitle: Supreme Court issues notice on bail pleas by Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam in 2020 Delhi riots case
items.summary: The Supreme Court has issued a notice regarding bail pleas by Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam in connection with the 2020 Delhi riots case. The court declined to grant interim relief, and Chief Justice will establish a three-judge bench to examine whether prolonged incarceration and trial delays can override stringent bail curbs under UAPA. The case involves complex questions about due process and anti-terrorism law.

items.title: India advances to Women's Asian Champions Trophy semi-finals
items.feedTitle: India thrash Japan 4-0 to enter Women’s Asian Champions Trophy semi-finals
items.summary: India's women's hockey team defeated Japan 4-0 to secure passage to the semi-finals of the Women's Asian Champions Trophy. The dominant victory advances the team through the group stage of the continental competition. India demonstrated strong offensive performance in the match.

immigration.title: IBM ends green card sponsorship for H-1B employees
immigration.feedTitle: IBM ends green card sponsorship, H-1B employees could face 80% pay cut or exit - People Matters
immigration.summary: IBM has ended green card sponsorship and given H-1B visa holders in its major divisions three weeks to choose between relocation or job loss, with some facing potential 80% pay cuts if forced to move. The move affects a significant portion of IBM's workforce and signals a major shift in employment-based immigration sponsorship by a major tech firm. This is finalized and in effect immediately.

immigration.title: DOL proposes sweeping PERM labor certification overhaul
immigration.feedTitle: Modernizing the Labor Market Test and Improving Protections for U.S. Workers in the PERM Immigrant Visa Program
immigration.summary: The Department of Labor has proposed major changes to the PERM (Permanent Labor Certification) process, the foundational step for employment-based green card sponsorship. The proposed rule, still pending finalization, aims to strengthen labor market testing standards and worker protections. This represents the biggest PERM overhaul since 2005 and directly affects how employers sponsor permanent immigration petitions.

immigration.title: H-1B premium processing fee rises to $2,965 for FY2028
immigration.feedTitle: H-1B premium processing costs $2,965 ahead of FY2028 lottery: What Indian F-1 OPT workers must know about rules and cap-gap
immigration.summary: USCIS has increased the H-1B visa premium processing fee to $2,965 ahead of the FY2028 lottery, affecting Indian F-1 OPT workers and other H-1B applicants seeking expedited processing. The fee increase applies to new filings. This is finalized and in effect for current petition cycles.

items.title: Indian IT stocks rally for fourth consecutive session
items.feedTitle: TCS, Infosys, Wipro: NIFTY IT gains 7% as IT stocks rally for fourth straight session; growth challenges ahead?
items.summary: India's NIFTY IT index surged 7% as TCS, Infosys, and Wipro led gains over four consecutive trading days, with analysts noting sector momentum but flagging ahead growth challenges. The rally reflects positive sentiment in the tech sector despite broader market volatility. However, experts caution about headwinds in IT spending and growth going forward.

items.title: US inflation hits highest level since May at 3.8%
items.feedTitle: US inflation hits highest since May after prices climb 3.8% over the last year
items.summary: US inflation climbed to 3.8% over the last year in October, reaching its highest level since May, driven by soaring energy prices and other cost pressures. The reading adds to concerns ahead of a crucial Federal Reserve board meeting. The uptick in inflation contradicts earlier hopes for cooling price pressures and complicates the Fed's policy outlook.

items.title: S&P warns Nvidia's governance may warrant credit cut
items.feedTitle: S&P warns Nvidia's board may be compromised, puts chipmaker's rating on downgrade watch
items.summary: S&P Global has placed Nvidia on negative watch for a potential credit rating downgrade, citing rising management and governance concerns following recent CEO turmoil. The rating agency flagged questions about board independence and decision-making around executive leadership changes. The warning reflects broader investor concerns about the company's governance amid the Jensen Huang controversy.

items.title: SpaceX wins FCC approval for 1 million data satellites
items.feedTitle: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
items.summary: The FCC has granted SpaceX approval to deploy up to 1 million satellites for orbital data center operations, a historic authorization for space-based computing infrastructure. Scientists have expressed skepticism about the environmental and space debris implications of such a large constellation. The approval represents a significant expansion of SpaceX's authorized satellite operations.

finance.note: Oil eased from recent highs, providing modest relief to inflation concerns, while Asian and Indian markets rebounded sharply after Tuesday's AI-driven sell-off. US stocks remain volatile as investors weigh tariff risks against tech recovery, with Nvidia's governance crisis adding uncertainty to AI sector leadership.

cards.title: Tariff timing and spending
cards.insight: Trump's new tariffs (effective early 2027) will raise prices on imports from China and other partners. Consumers may face higher costs on electronics, clothing, and goods in Q1 2027, making holiday spending and post-holiday purchases more expensive.
cards.takeaway: Front-load discretionary purchases before year-end if items are imported; review monthly budgets for Q1 2027 to absorb likely price increases on essentials.

cards.title: Stock market volatility and your portfolio
cards.insight: Recent wild swings (AI sell-offs, tariff fears, inflation data) underscore that short-term noise should not drive long-term asset allocation. Investors who panic-sold during dips missed rapid recoveries the same day.
cards.takeaway: Review your asset allocation (stocks/bonds/cash) and rebalance if needed, but do not chase daily market moves; stay disciplined to your plan.

cards.title: Immigration changes and job mobility
cards.insight: IBM's abrupt end to green card sponsorship and DOL's PERM overhaul signal tighter employment-based immigration. H-1B visa holders and green card applicants face new uncertainty; companies are pulling back sponsorship commitments.
cards.takeaway: If you rely on employer sponsorship or plan to, clarify your company's current policy now; explore backup plans or negotiate terms before major policy shifts take effect.

cards.title: Holiday borrowing caution
cards.insight: High inflation (3.8% YoY) and rising credit card delinquencies mean debt is becoming more expensive to carry. Survey data shows 76% of holiday spenders fear overspending; many cite FOMO or poor planning as reasons.
cards.takeaway: Set a strict holiday budget, use cash or debit to avoid impulse purchases, and pay off high-interest debt before year-end to avoid January surprise bills.

ai.title: Chinese firms buying Nvidia's advanced chips despite US ban
ai.feedTitle: CBS News Investigation Finds US Firms With Chinese Owners Buying Advanced Nvidia Chips
ai.summary: A CBS News investigation revealed that two California-based companies with Chinese ownership are actively purchasing Nvidia's most advanced AI chips, circumventing US export controls designed to prevent China from accessing cutting-edge technology. The findings raise serious questions about the enforcement of export restrictions and national security vulnerabilities. Investigators traced how Chinese interests access restricted technology through legal loopholes.

ai.title: Anthropic CEO denies AI should govern human free will
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic CEO Amodei denies wanting humanity to ‘surrender’ free will to AI
ai.summary: Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, pushed back against characterizations that the company wants AI systems to supplant human decision-making, saying predictions of AI matching or surpassing human intelligence do not imply humans should "surrender" agency. His remarks came amid broader debate about AI's expanding capabilities and appropriate human oversight. Amodei emphasized Anthropic's focus on AI safety and alignment.

ai.title: Chinese AI chips to jump sixfold by 2030, UBS says
ai.feedTitle: Chinese AI chips to jump nearly sixfold by 2030, UBS says, as Nvidia woes mount
ai.summary: UBS predicts that Chinese AI chip production will increase nearly sixfold by 2030 as Beijing invests in semiconductor self-sufficiency amid US export controls. The forecast comes as Nvidia faces mounting scrutiny over how its advanced chips reach Chinese buyers. The projection highlights the race between US restrictions and Chinese chip development capacity.

ai.title: Anthropic migrates Claude API from Python to Rust
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic says it moved its Claude API from Python to Rust with no downtime
ai.summary: Anthropic announced it successfully migrated its Claude API infrastructure from Python to Rust without any service downtime, improving performance and reliability. The migration represents a significant engineering undertaking for a production AI service. The move demonstrates advances in systems architecture for large-scale AI deployments.

ai.title: OpenAI hires Cravath litigator for Musk court battle
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI taps Cravath litigator for court showdown with Musk over AI dominance
ai.summary: OpenAI has tapped a prominent Cravath litigator as it prepares for court proceedings with Elon Musk over AI dominance and corporate control issues. The legal hiring signals escalating tensions between the AI company and its former backer. The case touches on fundamental questions about AI development, profit orientation, and corporate governance.
